comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer on roller slides, close it, then pull-test it; candidate screens media from parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual drawer carrying, hook/roller clearance alignment and sliding versus pouring and agitation of a perforated screen.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer must be on its slides, previously closed hands-off, then open 30–80 mm with load retained; candidate succeeds by mass recovery, washer retention and released support dwell.
comparison.reason: Shared load retention and bimanual handling are generic; the tested engagement and flow abilities differ.
